writer: moe-weekly-performance-memory via scripts/hook_weights.py apply — never hand-edited

Reserve for product launches. Test 4-5 launch teasers next cycle.

hook_weights.name: Multi-post product launch arc (mystery teaser → reveal → date-lock + countdown — 3+ sequenced posts over 5-7 days)
rules: Minimum 3 posts over a 5-7 day arc with narrative escalation: (1) mystery + drop date implied, (2) visual reveal + product name implied, (3) named product + explicit date-lock + scarcity.
Always include a LinkedIn image+copy beat in the launch arc (SYN-20260531).
Giveaway/sweepstakes mechanics amplify only INSIDE the arc — never as decontextualized standalone blasts (EP-013).
After the date-lock, extend the arc with PARTICIPATION beats (hide -> hunt -> winner announcement with live scarcity count) — never another 'it's here' repost (EP-014, 2nd-cycle).
hook_weights.notes: Performance Memory SYN-20260522 (NEW CP-015): Golden Pear launch arc — 9 posts across IG/FB/TT/LinkedIn over May 1-6, 4 of 9 hit NCS 100. FB Reel step 2 ("New look. New flavor. New obsession. Coming soon.") = 41,043 imp / 3,148 eng / 7.67% ER / NCS 100 — largest single-post FB engagement event since CP-010 Ashton Hall. IG step 3 ("Some of you guessed it. Golden Pear is here. May 13th.") = 21,105 imp / 712 eng / 3.37% / NCS 100. LinkedIn launch teaser hit 11.11% engagement (n=1). The teaser ALONE is weak (EP-010 stayed LOW confidence last cycle); the FULL ARC is what crosses NCS 100. **Cross-platform (IG/FB/TT/LinkedIn). HIGH confidence — 9-post validation across 4 platforms.** Promotes EP-010 to confirmed CP-015. Template for Larry: minimum 3 posts, 5-7 day arc, narrative escalation = (1) mystery + drop date implied, (2) visual reveal + product name implied, (3) named product + explicit date-lock + scarcity ("limited run"). Test on next flavor drop and next product launch. **UPDATE SYN-20260531: arc CONFIRMED on LinkedIn — Golden Pear sweepstakes posts drove LI new-window median to 18.22% (n=5), incl. 'Day 2 of the Golden Pear Sweepstakes' 36.65% and 'To every mom…' 35.64%. Always include a LinkedIn image+copy beat in the launch arc. CAVEAT (EP-013): the sweepstakes mechanic only amplifies INSIDE the arc — standalone 'WANT TO WIN BIG' reposts landed NCS 7-23. Frame giveaways as part of the launch narrative, never as decontextualized blasts. UPDATE SYN-20260612 (EP-014 → MEDIUM, 2nd-cycle validation): after the date-lock, extend the arc with PARTICIPATION beats — hide → hunt → winner announcement with live scarcity count ('We have our first winner… 4 still out there') hit FB 5.98% / NCS 97.3 and IG 3.08% / NCS 99.2 — never another 'it's here' repost (this window's boosted flavor-drop reposts ran 191K/42K/34K imp at 0.35–1.34% ER).**

hook_weights.name: Cultural-moment remembrance, NO commerce CTA
hook_weights.example: This MDW, we're remembering and honoring…
rules: On solemn cultural moments (Memorial Day, 9/11, Veterans Day) lead with a no-CTA remembrance post; run commerce/donation mechanics as SEPARATE posts judged on conversion, not ER.
hook_weights.notes: Performance Memory SYN-20260612 (NEW EP-015): pure MDW remembrance reels hit FB 6.67% / 114,873 imp (largest organic FB engagement event of the cycle), IG 6.18% / 77,475 imp, TT 5.48%. The SAME moment with donation/discount CTA (Grey Team 5% + GOVX 30%) landed 1.74–2.52% — a ~3x gap. **Cross-platform (FB/IG/TT). MEDIUM confidence — 1 cycle, exceptional reach evidence.** RULE: on solemn cultural moments (Memorial Day, 9/11, Veterans Day), lead with a no-CTA remembrance post; run commerce/donation mechanics as SEPARATE posts judged on conversion, not ER.

LOW confidence — 1 cycle, FB-only.** Belongs to the Problem-agitation family (1.8). Respect the AP-008 same-body 1x/7d cap when scaling; test on IG/TT and isolate time-of-day next cycle.

hook_weights.notes: Performance Memory SYN-20260706 (NEW EP-018): owned IG feed posts that open on a specific named athlete/ambassador + narrate their routine with Kenetik as fuel all hit NCS 100 — Razo Rob 23.6% ER / 2,451 imp, Derek 8.0% ER / 8,940 imp (highest-reach IG winner), Rio Hawkins 7.6% / 1,819 imp. MEDIUM-LOW confidence — 1 cycle.** Test the named-individual open on TikTok/FB owned next cycle. **UPDATE SYN-20260710 (2nd cycle): confirmed on IG (NCS 100 / 8,591 imp), EXTENDS to owned FB (NCS 92.6), FALSIFIED on LinkedIn (identical body NCS 14.4) → confidence MEDIUM. Generalizes from athlete-routine to helper/community narrative ("Adam sets up a table for everyone else"). Scope: Instagram + Facebook owned; do NOT route this hook to LinkedIn. Owned TikTok still the one untested surface.**

Performance Memory (May 1): 6 YouTube cross-posts in window at 0.32% median engagement vs ~2.5% baseline expectation. YouTube needs native long-form (5-15 min) hooks. **STOP YouTube cross-posting until a real long-form strategy exists.**

anti_patterns.name: No caption / Amazon listing text on Instagram
rules: Empty-caption publish gate is holding (2 consecutive clean feed/reel windows, SYN-20260619) — keep a passive monitor only; IG Stories are caption-free by design and tracked separately.
anti_patterns.notes: Performance Memory (May 8): 20 new captionless IG posts in 8 days (cumulative 110+, AP-001 worsened 3rd consecutive cycle) at <0.5% engagement. **Block IG publish at workflow level if caption < 50 chars. Re-escalated to Devon — fix workflow this week.** **UPDATE SYN-20260619: 2ND CONSECUTIVE CLEAN feed/reel window — 6/6 eligible IG feed/reel captioned (median 3.53%); the 24 captionless items are IG STORIES (caption-free by design, tracked separately). The empty-caption publish gate is holding → DOWNGRADE feed/reel captionless to RESOLVED; keep a passive monitor only.**

anti_patterns.name: Same-day giveaway variant saturation (>1 variant of same offer per platform per day)
rules: Max 1 giveaway-mechanic post per platform per day; stagger variants 24-48h apart.
Larry's content scheduler must enforce a 24h same-offer cooldown on FB.
anti_patterns.notes: Performance Memory SYN-20260508 (AP-007): Cam Jones Unbound giveaway 4 FB variants on Apr 17 — combined 24,750 imp (huge reach) but 2.27% mean engagement (0.62x FB median), all variants NCS<35. Same hook in single-post form last cycle hit 11.11% / NCS 91.2. Frequency, not the hook, was the failure. **RULE: max 1 giveaway-mechanic post per platform per day; stagger variants 24-48h apart. Larry's content scheduler must enforce a 24h same-offer cooldown on FB.**

anti_patterns.name: Automated bulk-publish of identical retail/PR copy on Facebook (>1 identical body per platform per day, same-second cluster)
rules: Deduplicate post bodies per-platform per-day BEFORE publish; cap same-body variants at 1/24h (extends the AP-007 rule to body text).
Identify and disable the auto-poster producing same-second clusters — FB spam detection suppresses entire batches (most severe FB anti-pattern in the program).
anti_patterns.notes: Performance Memory SYN-20260522 (NEW AP-010): 12 identical "Find Kenetik at Dierbergs!" FB posts published within 3 seconds (May 6 20:57:21-24Z) — ALL 12 lifetime.impressions=0. 14 identical "Kenetik's a disruptor in the healthy energy drink market" FB posts published within 14 seconds (May 5 17:47:42-18:01:33Z) — ALL 14 lifetime.impressions=0. 26 zero-reach FB posts in 5 days. FB spam detection flagged the cluster pattern and suppressed entire batches. **MOST SEVERE FB anti-pattern in the program.** Level-2 Remove fix: deduplicate post bodies per-platform per-day BEFORE publish; cap same-body variants at 1/24h (extends AP-007 rule to body text, not just giveaway mechanics). Identify and disable the auto-poster producing these clusters.

anti_patterns.name: Cart-recovery / transactional email copy on organic social ('🚨 Forgot something? Transform your tomorrow, today. Check out now…')
rules: Transactional/cart-recovery copy belongs in Klaviyo email/SMS + paid retargeting ONLY — never organic social; Larry's queue must reject transactional-CTA bodies on organic surfaces.
anti_patterns.notes: Performance Memory SYN-20260531 (NEW AP-011): 3 FB cart-recovery posts at NCS 5 / 0% ER / 10-88 imp. Abandoned-cart and checkout-CTA copy has no social hook and the feed algorithm ignores the hard transactional CTA. **RULE: transactional/cart-recovery copy belongs in Klaviyo email/SMS + paid retargeting ONLY — never organic social. Larry's queue must reject transactional-CTA bodies on organic surfaces.**
